changelog:
- Initial release of voice-memory skill for ClawHub.
- Provides automatic, persistent memory for voice agents using BlueColumn.
- Enables storage and recall of voice conversations, meetings, coaching, sales calls, and journal entries.
- Requires BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Includes access to a full suite of memory-related features and offline test modules.
summary: Your voice agent remembers forever. Give voice agents automatic memory of every conversation using BlueColumn. Use when a voice/phone agent must remember callers, meetings, coaching sessions, sales calls, or journal entries; when wiring voice transcripts into BlueColumn; or when a caller needs continuity across calls. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
